definition: Total simulated sleep duration
measurement_window: most recent sleep episode completed before cutoff
derivation: Generated by uncalibrated stochastic simulator; not a real measurement
interpretation: Exploratory importance on reused synthetic validation; correlated/derived inputs can share attribution. Not causal or a stand-alone deletion rule.

definition: Simulated percent of sleep opportunity spent asleep; opportunity includes onset delay and at least three awake minutes per awakening
derivation: Initial stochastic efficiency capped at 100*sleep_duration_hours/(sleep_duration_hours+(sleep_onset_delay_minutes+3*awakenings_count)/60), rounded down to 0.001 percentage point
interpretation: Exploratory importance on reused synthetic validation; correlated/derived inputs can share attribution. Not causal or a stand-alone deletion rule.
